<style>
  .pagehead { position: relative; padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + clamp(60px, 9vw, 120px)); padding-bottom: clamp(50px, 7vw, 96px); background: radial-gradient(120% 130% at 78% 0%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  .pagehead .wrap { position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .pagehead h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 22px 0 24px; max-width: 16ch; }
  .pagehead .lead { max-width: 52ch; }
  .ph-motif { position: absolute; right: -120px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 460px; height: 460px; z-index: 1; opacity: 0.6; }
  .ph-motif circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--line-gold); stroke-width: 0.8; }
  .ph-motif .spin { transform-origin: 230px 230px; animation: spin 60s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  .svc-detail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.85fr 1.15fr; gap: clamp(30px, 6vw, 90px); padding-block: clamp(56px, 7vw, 96px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); align-items: start; }
  .svc-detail:first-of-type { border-top: 0; }
  .svc-detail .sd-left { position: sticky; top: 110px; }
  .svc-detail .sd-num { font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 7vw, 6rem); color: var(--line); line-height: 0.8; }
.sd-num::before { content: attr(data-n); }
  .js .svc-detail:hover .sd-num, .svc-detail.in .sd-num { color: var(--accent-ink); transition: color 0.8s var(--ease); }
  .svc-detail h2 { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.9rem); margin: 18px 0 0; }
  .svc-detail .tag { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid var(--line-gold); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 2px; }
  .svc-detail .sd-body p { font-size: 1.12rem; color: var(--ink); max-width: 54ch; margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .deliverables { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1px; background: var(--line); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .deliverables li { list-style: none; background: var(--surface); padding: 18px 20px; font-size: 0.98rem; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; transition: background 0.4s var(--ease); }
  .deliverables li:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, var(--surface)); }
  .deliverables li::before { content: "→"; color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 2px; }

  @media (max-width: 820px) {
    .svc-detail { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
    .svc-detail .sd-left { position: static; }
    .deliverables { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .ph-motif { opacity: 0.3; right: -200px; }
  }
</style>
